title: StoneEra just hit 400 wishlists — 70+ new additions while day one of Next Fest is still going!
author: Arrock12

comments.author: Three_Tails_Studio
comments.body:
Hard for us to support this dev after seeing how he speaks to people on Reddit 👎🏼

Remember everyone, please treat others with respect ❤️

replies.author: Arrock12
replies.body:
I respect your opinion, but are you seriously suggesting that I should just stay silent when those same people are trying to insult me?  
Hmm, that makes me question the values you’re advocating a little. Respect should go both ways, shouldn’t it?

replies.author: Arrock12
replies.body:
Looks like your comment was deleted, but I'll respond anyway.

You say no one was insulting me, and then immediately call me a liar.

So now I'm curious — if I respond to this comment too, are you going to get upset again and remember my username and game because of it?
